note: Real per-item correctness from the 2026-06-17 gfx1100 runs (MR !633 easy, MR !634 hard), captured for offline routing analysis. 'wrong' lists the item ids each lane scored INCORRECT; every other item in the dataset was scored correct. latency_p50_s is the per-tier, per-lane p50 quality-answer latency from those same runs, used as a per-item latency estimate for the routing projection (per-item latency was not persisted, only the p50). The two lanes' error sets are DISJOINT within each tier, so a per-item oracle scores 100%.
